title: Work transfers: enforce one Work tab per pane without losing the source
outcome: Parent review Codex session-6980 Medium; verified by parent source inspection. placeDraggedTab removes the source before addWorkspaceTabToPane; insertTabAtIndex deduplicates IDs only. placeExternalTab has the same singleton gap. Two Work tabs survive a transfer into a pane already containing Work. Enforce the invariant at the shared transfer/insertion boundary with deliberate coalescing or refusal preserving source and transaction identity. Add same-window and cross-window regressions and reopen-survivor assertions. No runtime reproduction performed; original full gates pass without this coverage.
